title: DTC Direct Tax Code
definition: The Direct Taxes Code (DTC) was proposed as a comprehensive legislation to replace the archaic Income Tax Act of 1961, aiming to simplify direct tax laws, widen the tax base, reduce litigation, and phase out exemptions.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (Taxation, Economic Reforms, Budget) and Mains GS Paper 3 (Indian Economy and issues relating to resource mobilization, tax reforms, and black money).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and historical evolution of the Direct Taxes Code.
Evaluate structural differences between the Income Tax Act 1961 and proposed DTC reforms.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions regarding tax administration.
